name: the real look's renderer
about: What RealLook (src/render/real_look.gd) sets on the street's environment while the real look is on (docs/briefs/red-dead.md R0), each put back when it goes off. LookPreset addresses. The realistic renderer's own dials: AgX (the filmic curve), SSIL (bounce light in screen space), SDFGI (bounce light from the world's distance field; RealLook eases its energy to real.sdfgi_indoor under a roof, so indoors stays RoomLight's), the volumetric fog taking bounce light, the glow only for what's over white. Exposure is real.exposure (a camera-attributes multiplier: DayCycle keeps setting the tonemap's own). R0's renders: AgX's contrast 1.25 and SSIL 0.8 with exposure 1.6 read milky; 1.5, 0.6 and 1.4 kept the shade's shape.
